description: This Java source file defines a test service class 'ServiceEngineTestServices' inside the package 'org.apache.ofbiz.service.test'. The class includes multiple static methods implementing various service logic, mainly for testing concurrency, locking, transactions, and error handling in the context of the OFBiz framework. It interacts with entities, dispatches other services, and manipulates data records, serving as a test suite for service engine behaviors.

classes.name: ServiceEngineTestServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for testing various aspects of the OFBiz service engine, including concurrency, locking, transactions, and event handling.

methods.name: testServiceDeadLockRetry
methods.description: Initiates a deadlock retry test by launching two asynchronous services and checking their results for errors.

methods.name: testServiceDeadLockRetryThreadA
methods.description: Performs a simulated lock acquisition and update sequence on specific 'TestingType' entities to help induce a deadlock scenario.

methods.name: testServiceDeadLockRetryThreadB
methods.description: Performs a complementary sequence to ThreadA, involving updates on different entities to induce deadlock conditions.

methods.name: testServiceLockWaitTimeoutRetry
methods.description: Tests lock wait timeout behavior by running two services asynchronously and checking for errors.

methods.name: testServiceLockWaitTimeoutRetryGrabber
methods.description: Locks a specific entity and waits longer than the lock timeout to simulate lock contention.

methods.name: testServiceLockWaitTimeoutRetryWaiter
methods.description: Attempts to update the same entity, expecting a lock wait timeout due to the Grabber service.

methods.name: testServiceLockWaitTimeoutRetryCantRecover
methods.description: Simulates a scenario where a lock wait timeout cannot be recovered by running a sub-service in a separate transaction.

methods.name: testServiceLockWaitTimeoutRetryCantRecoverWaiter
methods.description: Attempts to lock the same entity expecting a timeout, resulting in a failure.

methods.name: testServiceOwnTxSubServiceAfterSetRollbackOnlyInParentErrorCatchWrapper
methods.description: Runs a sub-service after setting rollback only in parent, catching and logging expected errors.

methods.name: testServiceOwnTxSubServiceAfterSetRollbackOnlyInParent
methods.description: Modifies an entity, sets the transaction to rollback only, and runs a sub-service in its own transaction to test rollback behavior.

methods.name: testServiceOwnTxSubServiceAfterSetRollbackOnlyInParentSubService
methods.description: A placeholder or wrapper for sub-service; in this context, it performs no operations.

methods.name: testServiceEcaGlobalEventExec
methods.description: Triggers another service to test event-driven global execution behavior.

methods.name: testServiceEcaGlobalEventExecOnCommit
methods.description: Updates an entity to test behavior on global commit events.

methods.name: testServiceEcaGlobalEventExecToRollback
methods.description: Placeholder for testing global rollback behavior, returns an error:

methods.name: testServiceEcaGlobalEventExecOnRollback
methods.description: Updates an entity to test behavior on global rollback post-events.
